title: Proactive smoke + adaptive eval firing for catalog and tenant version pins
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Implement a two-stage, tenant-aware automated eval trigger for model version pins (catalog and customer-pinned). The flow starts with a quick smoke probe (low-cost, deterministic prompt set) and conditionally escalates to higher-fidelity targeted evals for affected customer cohorts. The system must respect tenant budgets, apply sampling and backpressure, and produce actionable signals (regression score, failing prompts, recommended rollback/fallback model). Integrate with Rollouts and Alerts so operators can automate canary hold/rollback or surface to SRE/PM desks.
acceptance_criteria: When a model version is pinned (catalog or tenant), a smoke eval job runs within 2 minutes with <5% added latency to the pin operation
If smoke eval crosses defined thresholds (accuracy/regression delta/LLM-specific metrics), the system automatically schedules targeted evals for top-affected tenants within 30 minutes
Tenant-aware throttles ensure no tenant consumes more than their eval budget; default budget enforcement prevents runaway costs
Eval results produce a succinct regression score, top 5 failing prompts, and suggested mitigation (rollback to prior pin or route to fallback model)
Rollout integration: canary hold triggers and optional automatic rollback hooks are available and documented
Console: per-pin eval summary is visible in the Pin detail page with provenance links to raw eval runs, PRDs, and related GitHub PRs
API/Webhooks: external consumers receive an eval webhook for downstream automation within 5 minutes of targeted-eval completion
End-to-end tests: synthetic end-to-end test verifies smoke -> escalation -> webhook path in CI
implementation_notes: Stage 1: Smoke probe - curated deterministic prompt set (10-25 prompts) run against new pin; lightweight metrics: exact-match, BLEU-like token metrics, and latency distribution
Stage 2: Adaptive targeted evals - select prompt buckets associated with high-risk flows (billing, auth, safety) and sample tenant traffic based on impact score and budget
Sampling policy: prioritize tenants by recent traffic weight + feature sensitivity; apply reservoir sampling with per-tenant cap
Budgeting: wire into Optimize cost-guard; if tenant runs out of eval credits, mark as deferred and surface in UI
Backpressure: if eval fleet is saturated, drop to low-fidelity probes and enqueue high-fidelity runs with ETA and notifications
Signals: compute delta vs baseline (previous pin) and vs catalog baseline; store both absolute and normalized deltas
Outputs: regression_score (0-100), failing_prompt_examples (top-5), suggested_action (rollback/fallback/accept-with-note), and artifacts link to raw eval traces
Integrations: hooks for Rollouts API, Alerts (PagerDuty/SLA dashboards), Console pin UI, and webhooks for tenant automation
Privacy: do not include PII in stored prompt examples; apply redaction and sampling rules per Privacy playbook
rollout_plan: Phase 0 - feature flag gated: run smoke-only for catalog pins for first week; collect metrics and false-positive rates
Phase 1 - tenant opt-in: allow customers to opt-in to targeted evals and per-tenant budgeting controls
Phase 2 - gradual enforcement: enable targeted eval escalation for 20% of tenant traffic; monitor cost impact
Phase 3 - full auto policy: enable for all catalog pins with enforced budgets and automatic rollback for high-severity regressions
Post-launch: continuous tuning of sampling rates and thresholds based on observed FP/FN and cost-per-detection
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: high eval costs from bursty pins -> Mitigation: per-pin budget caps and adaptive sampling; reject non-critical heavy jobs
Risk: noisy smoke probes causing unnecessary rollbacks -> Mitigation: conservative thresholds, require multi-signal confirmation before auto-rollback
Risk: PII leakage in example prompts -> Mitigation: run redaction pipeline and limit storage TTL for raw prompt traces
Risk: eval fleet saturation affecting production inference -> Mitigation: strict isolation and quotaing; run evals on dedicated pool or lower-priority nodes
